theorem _root_.CompressionEval.smoke_nt_01 (a b c : ℕ) (hb : a ∣ b) (hc : a ∣ c) :
  a ∣ 2 * b + 3 * c :=
by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hb
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hc
  refine ⟨2 * u + 3 * v, ?_⟩
  ring
